tools.name: create_space_note

justifications.readOnlyHint: Persists a new plain-text note visible to the saved space members. Requires permission to add meetings to that space.
justifications.destructiveHint: Adds a note without replacing or deleting an existing note.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated identical calls can create multiple notes.
justifications.openWorldHint: The operation is confined to authorized meetings or spaces in Tactiq; it cannot target arbitrary external recipients or public destinations.

tools.registration: Requires the space-linked-resources rollout for this account.

tools.name: delete_space_note

justifications.readOnlyHint: Removes an existing space note after verifying write permission.
justifications.destructiveHint: Permanently deletes the note for every member of the space.
justifications.idempotentHint: The server does not promise repeat-safe successful deletion: the first call removes the target and a later lookup can fail.
justifications.openWorldHint: The operation is confined to authorized meetings or spaces in Tactiq; it cannot target arbitrary external recipients or public destinations.

tools.name: update_space_note

justifications.readOnlyHint: Persists replacements for the complete title and text of an existing space note, with write-permission checks.
justifications.destructiveHint: Overwrites the previous title and full text for all space members; omitted text can be lost.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the same replacement leaves the same title and text. Modification timestamps and operational audit data may still change.
justifications.openWorldHint: The operation is confined to authorized meetings or spaces in Tactiq; it cannot target arbitrary external recipients or public destinations.
